what_happened: Scene: layout 1 (dark-grey cabinets, brick wall), 4-element black glass electric range with front knobs; pan_5 (black pan, long tan wooden handle with a black neck) in an upper cabinet; target front_right; steak on a plate right of the range. Stage 0 took 1970 steps (median 378, p90 813) because of two failed grasps and a drop. (1) 188-340: fingers at the handle with the handle lying across the fingers; close 327 (width 0.027) slipped, fingers fully closed at 352; close on air at 400; 400-700 it backed off and hovered. (2) 721: closed on the handle and pulled the pan out (hold 736-791, lift 0.09 m) while the base turned; the pan hung from the handle and slipped out at ~792, falling 0.52 m onto the counter in front of the robot, landing flat and upright with the handle toward the robot. (3) 820-1300 the policy turned to the range empty-handed and looked at the burners (no place attempt, gripper partly open), then came back to the pan on the counter (1440-1500), grasped the tan handle just below the black neck with the handle running toward the camera between the fingers (close 1491, hold 1506-1949, lifted ~0.48 m), carried it to the range and released it on front_right at 1949 (0.056 m). Stage 0 complete 1970. Stage 1: steak grasped at 2075-2087, released into the pan at 2166 (stage 1 at 2166, 196 steps, normal). Stage 2: knob contact 2373-2560, front_right 0.05 (2464) -> 0.36 (2560): success 2558, only 342 steps before the horizon.
self_recovery: Recovered from a slipped grasp (327-352) and from a dropped pan (~792): re-grasped the pan from the counter at 1491 with a body-side handle grasp and completed all stages. The drop landed the pan upright on the counter within reach, which made the recovery possible; in s2/s4/s9/s13 the pan fell to the floor, off the counter or upside down and the policy never retried.

packet_facts: pan holds 293-296; 736-791 lift 0.094 drop 0.524; 1506-1949 lift 0.481 at_target dist 0.0565

uncertain_about: Whether the 820-1300 phase was a deliberate empty 'place' or just exploration; the gripper stayed partly open and no knob was touched.
